reveal_en: There's a jellyfish species, Turritopsis dohrnii, capable of reversing its aging process. If stressed, it can revert to an immature polyp stage and grow anew, effectively bypassing death by old age.
reveal_zh: 有一种水母，灯塔水母，能够逆转其衰老过程。当受到威胁时，它能变回幼年水螅体，并重新生长，从而避免因衰老而死亡。
meaning_en: This discovery challenges our fundamental understanding of life cycles, suggesting that biological aging is not always a one-way street.
meaning_zh: 这一发现挑战了我们对生命周期的基本理解，表明生物衰老并非总是单向的。

visual.motion: Gentle, continuous regeneration of form, resembling a subtle pulse.
